Poster tray

every poster starts here

How to move a poster: drag it with your mouse or finger. On a touchscreen you can also tap a poster to pick it up, then tap the tier you want, or use the tier buttons that appear at the bottom of the screen. With a keyboard, focus a poster and press S, A, B, C, D or F to send it to that tier, or T to send it back to the tray. Tap the expand button on a poster to see it full size before you judge it.
